name: Golden Sea helper

roleNotes.note: Supply chain & customer service: reads the inbox, creates cases, sends supplier RFQs and chases replies, compares offers, prices lines and prepares quotations.
Sales: owns customer relationships and quotations, follows customer decisions and POs, and grows accounts. Sales never sees costs or margins.
suggestions: Which quotations are waiting for the customer?

roleNotes.note: Management approver: decides approvals (margin exceptions, payments, bank-detail changes), watches the control room, and steers by blockers, cash and profit.
Finance: receivables and payables, collection reminders, payment approvals and bank-detail checks, invoices and e-invoicing.
Operations: supplier POs, receiving, deliveries to vessels, proof of delivery and claims.
Office admin: the inbox, contacts, vendor registrations and documents.

suggestions: Take me to the offer comparison for Aurora Crest

examples.question: how do I send a quotation?
